summary: Measured five declared gates with Chromium DOM and computed-style probes. build-health, token-drift, responsive-geometry and state-coverage pass. accessibility fails on two counts: zero heading elements and --ink-dim at 4.49:1. axe-core is not installed, and the required 'state captures' output could not be produced.

claims.claim: The page contains zero heading elements; h1 count is 0 and total headings is 0.
--ink-dim resolves to rgb(111,111,112) on paper rgb(244,242,237), a contrast ratio of 4.49:1, which fails WCAG AA for the 13px and 15px text it is applied to.
Token drift is zero: all 3 hex literals in the file sit inside custom property declarations, and the 7 literal px values are structural rather than color or type.
axe-core, declared in the phase kit with authority deterministic-evidence, is not installed; the accessibility gate ran on DOM probes instead.
The declared output 'state captures' was not produced, because --screenshot alone cannot drive interaction before capture.
shot-375.png is invalid as mobile evidence: headless=new pinned innerWidth at 500px, so the page was laid out at 500 and cropped to 375.

risks: Two of five gates in this phase were measured with an instrument weaker than the one the kit declares.
A declared phase output is missing and nothing in the system detects that.
unresolved: state captures not produced — capability gap
